description: This Go source file defines a client library for interacting with the AgentField control plane REST API. It contains the Client struct with methods to register nodes, update status, acknowledge actions, and shutdown nodes, handling HTTP requests and responses. It also includes configuration options and error handling.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: A client for communicating with the AgentField control plane REST API, providing methods for node registration, status updates, acknowledgments, and shutdown.

methods.name: RegisterNode
methods.description: Registers or updates an agent node with the control plane, handling fallback for older endpoints.

methods.name: UpdateStatus
methods.description: Sends a status update (heartbeat) for a node, with fallback to legacy endpoint if needed.

methods.name: AcknowledgeAction
methods.description: Notifies the control plane that a specific action has been completed on a node.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Informs the control plane that a node is shutting down gracefully.

methods.name: do
methods.description: Internal helper to perform HTTP requests, handle headers, encode requests, and decode responses.

methods.name: legacyHeartbeat
methods.description: Fallback method for legacy heartbeat endpoint when the main update status endpoint returns 404.
